evidenceReviewed.meaning: Theme/index matches are leads for further assessment, not certified complete knowledge. All three already had separate recall cards.
Prior qualitative observations and single-fact recall wordings for halides, alcohols and carbonyl tests reviewed.

scopeRestrictions: All original hypothetical or provided observational data; no hands-on chemistry or laboratory procedure instructions.
School AS required practicals 4–6 only; later Year 2 practicals 7–9,11–12 excluded.
Does not teach untaught buffers, spectroscopy or extended Year 2 topics.
Maths school mock remains AQA Year 1 Pure only. No cards, XP, profile, World or progress keys changed.
limitations: AQA's written-paper practical assessment encompasses further skill areas; nine questions do not certify entire practical competency or each official assessment criterion.
The prior practical flashcard counts use keyword/index matches; no claim that all 33 cards have been independently mapped to every AQA bullet.
New original model answers are not AQA-authorised mark schemes. Equivalent student working and unfamiliar phrasings may still need review.
2015–2026 original AQA past-paper indexing remains incomplete; no historical question reproduction.
